latest_release.body:
### Added

- *(rig-bridge)* Esc stops the program's turn, and a new process goes on from the session the program saved ([#3463](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3463)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-watch)* rig-watch, an optional plugin that wakes the agent when a file it waits on changes ([#3462](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3462)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-core)* refresh model catalog (Gemini 4 Neon, Copilot MAI-Code 2, Bedrock/Azure/Copilot GPT-6.2) ([#3458](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3458)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-bridge)* populate reasoning effort controls and reuse warm sessions across effort changes ([#3455](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3455)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-bridge)* add live quota probes for Grok, Antigravity, and Copilot in /bridge usage ([#3454](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3454)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-bridge)* other coding agents' CLIs as model providers ([#3445](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3445)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-tui)* add StickyPromptPlugin to pin off-screen user messages over top row ([#3451](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3451)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-tui)* recall waiting inbox message on Up when input is empty ([#3449](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3449)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-ecs)* skip unstarted tool calls when user steering arrives ([#3448](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3448)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-tui)* scroll half a page on PageUp and PageDown ([#3446](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3446)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))

### Fixed

- *(xtask)* seed agent_run_stepper Cargo.lock from the workspace root ([#3468](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3468)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-bridge)* rename Copilot CLI bridge vendor to copilot-cli to avoid built-in copilot catalog collision ([#3459](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3459)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-bridge)* emit per-turn Copilot usage deltas, tighten scratch-dir note, and share nested TMPDIR guard ([#3457](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3457)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))
- *(rig-bridge)* harden handshakes, probe isolation, Codex 0.171 flags, and warm recovery ([#3453](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3453)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))

### Other

- release v0.47.1 ([#3442](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3442)) (by [github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])) - #3442
- say how to merge through the merge queue in AGENTS.md ([#3456](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3456)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper)) - #3456
- remove the rig-claude-cloak plugin ([#3452](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3452)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper)) - #3452
- *(rig-basics, rig-tools)* tighten system prompt, framing, and tool descriptions ([#3447](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/pull/3447)) (by [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper))

### Contributors

* [gold-silver-copper](https://github.com/gold-silver-copper)
* [github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])

detail.readme: [![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/rig.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/rig) [![docs.rs](https://img.shields.io/docsrs/rig)](https://docs.rs/rig) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/511303648119226382?label=Discord)](https://discord.gg/playgrounds) Rig is a Rust library for building applications on large language models. It also ships `rig`, a terminal coding agent built on the library that you extend with Bevy plugins. ## The coding agent ```bash cargo install rig rig ``` This installs the launcher of the latest release. Each release's guide is on its tag, such as [0.47.0's guide](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/rig/blob/v0.47.0/docs/agent.md). The [agent guide](docs/agent.md#install-and-run) on `main` can be ahead of the release, and shows how to install `main` from a checkout. The agent needs Rust 1.97.1 or newer and runs on Linux and macOS. The first `rig` builds the agent, which takes several minutes, and opens it. Run `/login` to sign in or save an API key, or export one such as `OPENAI_API_KEY` before starting. `/model` picks a model and `/help` lists the commands. `rig -p "fix the failing test"` answers one prompt and exits. Its tools, commands, sessions, sign-in and terminal view are each a plugin, so any of them can be turned off, replaced or added to. `/reload` rebuilds the agent with your changes and keeps the session. - The [agent guide](docs/agent.md) covers updating, models, sessions, tools, settings and scripting. - The [plugin guide](crates/rig-harness/PLUGINS.md) explains the basics of a plugin and points at working examples of each kind. ## The library ```bash cargo add rig anyhow cargo add tokio --features macros,rt-multi-thread ``` ```rust use rig::prelude::*; use rig::providers::openai::{self, OpenAI}; #[tokio::main] async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> { // Reads OPENAI_API_KEY. let model = OpenAI::from_env()?.completion(openai::GPT_6_2_SOL); let agent = AgentBuilder::new(model) .preamble("You are a comedian.") .build(); let response = agent.prompt("Entertain me!").await?; println!("{}", response.output()); Ok(()) } ``` Rig puts over 20 model providers and a dozen vector stores behind one interface. It has agents with tools, streaming and typed hooks. It covers completion, embedding, transcription, audio and image models and follows the OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions. `rig-core` and `rig-agent` build for browser WASM. See [`examples/`](examples), the [guides](https://rig.rs/docs) and the [API reference](https://docs.rs/rig). ## Crates The `rig` crate re-exports `rig-core`. Its default features add `rig-agent`, the derive macros, the reqwest HTTP client with rustls and, on native targets, the `rig` launcher (feature `cli`, from `rig-cli`); `default-features = false` leaves them out. Each crate in the list below is a feature named after it without `rig-`: ```bash cargo add rig --features memory,fastembed ``` - Agents and state: [`rig-agent`](crates/rig-agent), [`rig-memory`](crates/rig-memory) (saved conversations), [`rig-cassette`](crates/rig-cassette) (record and replay), [`rig-rmcp`](crates/rig-rmcp) (MCP tools). - Models: [`rig-bedrock`](crates/rig-bedrock), [`rig-vertexai`](crates/rig-vertexai), [`rig-gemini-grpc`](crates/rig-gemini-grpc), [`rig-candle`](crates/rig-candle) (local models), [`rig-fastembed`](crates/rig-fastembed) (local embeddings), [`rig-typesafeai`](crates/rig-typesafeai) (TypeSafe Jev judgments). The vector stores, such as LanceDB, Qdrant and PostgreSQL, are companion crates behind features too; [docs.rs lists every feature](https://docs.rs/crate/rig/latest/features). Internals: [`rig-core`](crates/rig-core) (messages, models, tools, providers), [`rig-derive`](crates/rig-derive) (feature `derive`), [`rig-http`](crates/rig-http) (transport traits), [`rig-reqwest`](crates/rig-reqwest) (feature `reqwest`) and [`rig-tungstenite`](crates/rig-tungstenite) (feature `websocket`). Coding agent: [`rig-cli`](crates/rig-cli) (feature `cli`, the library of the `rig` binary) and, not facade features, [`rig-harness`](crates/rig-harness), [`rig-harness-protocol`](crates/rig-harness-protocol), [`rig-ecs`](crates/rig-ecs), [`rig-tools`](crates/rig-tools), [`rig-markdown`](crates/rig-markdown), and the plugins [`rig-basics`](plugins/rig-basics), [`rig-tui`](plugins/rig-tui), [`rig-fold`](plugins/rig-fold), [`rig-steel`](plugins/rig-steel), [`rig-mcp-client`](plugins/rig-mcp-client), [`rig-acp`](plugins/rig-acp), [`rig-inspect`](plugins/rig-inspect), [`rig-traffic`](plugins/rig-traffic), [`rig-bridge`](plugins/rig-bridge) and [`rig-watch`](plugins/rig-watch). ## Community Ask questions on [Discord](https://discord.gg/playgrounds). [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) says how to contribute, and [awesome-rig](https://github.com/0xPlaygrounds/awesome-rig) lists projects built on Rig. Rig is pre-1.0, so releases break APIs. The [changelog](CHANGELOG.md) and [migration notes](MIGRATING.md) say what changed. Rig is MIT licensed.
